bullets.text: A security guard named Kannaiyan died from electrocution after a power cable snapped near Avadi, and the office should monitor safety measures.
Heavy rain accompanied by thunderstorms lashed Velachery overnight, and the office should watch for waterlogging and relief updates.
The Okkiyam Maduvu project is set to be a major gamechanger for South Chennai drainage, and the office should monitor its progress.
The IMD issued an orange alert for heavy rainfall in Tiruvallur, and the district team should coordinate disaster response readiness.
Perumal temples in Thiruttani held special pujas for the last Saturday of Purattasi, and the office should track local festival arrangements.
The Vibrant Goa summit agenda includes major investments in data centres and an AI city, and the portfolio team should review infrastructure trends.
A new AI framework reads lung tumors with unusual precision on CT scans, and the portfolio team should monitor healthcare technology advancements.

stories.title: Security guard electrocuted after power cable snaps in Tirunindravur
takeaways: A 55-year-old security guard died after touching a live snapped power cable near Avadi.
The tragic accident highlights urgent electrical safety concerns during monsoon weather.
